working_definition: Somatic stem cells of the adult testis (CySCs), string-expressing, at the root of the cyst cell lineage; the start of the authors' cyst cell trajectory. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: A somatic stem cell; Mother of cyst cells; Associated with the hub of the germinal center and with male germline stem cells.

justification: FBbt:00004933 has exact synonyms CySC and somatic cyst stem cell and the related synonym 'cyst stem cell'; same somatic stem cell of the testis giving rise to cyst cells.
recommendation: Map to cyst progenitor cell (FBbt:00004933), exact.
